messages:
emily_sales: Quick escalation — HelixData exec wants signoff to move POC to Dedicated by EOD Fri. Main blockers: SSO SAML metadata + cert, security questionnaire flagged KMS/pentest, and POC pricing for dedicated GPUs. cc @ryan_se @priya_pm
ryan_se: Which SSO flow are they expecting? We support SAML and OIDC. If they need SAML we need their IdP metadata and cert. We can provide SP metadata. Also need contact at their IdP for testing.
priya_pm: POC infra ready on our side but they want IP allowlist + dedicated pool during POC. Ask: target qps and expected seq len distribution? That affects instance sizing and pricing.
marco_security: Security questionnaire outstanding: KMS key lifecycle, encryption at rest details, SOC2 report, latest pen test summary, and data flow diagram for egress. I can draft a one-pager for execs. We should provide an attestation for ephemeral logs retention.
sam_engineering: Tech note: their eval uses ~20–30k seqs in few heavy flows. Recommending we offer a quantized 16-bit variant on a dedicated T4/P4 equivalent for POC, or we propose burst autoscale policy. Also need to set prefix caching off for test.
emily_sales: Pricing ask from client: discount for POC dedicated pool + clear egress pricing. Can we offer a flat POC rate (2 weeks) and a committed rate if they convert? Need numbers for exec briefing.
leah_legal: I can fast-track the egress and SOW snippet. Need to know expected outbound egress GB/day. Also any 3rd-party data sharing?
ryan_se: I'll reach out to their SRE for IdP metadata now. emily — can you confirm qps/seq from their PM?
priya_pm: Confirmed: peak 80 qps, 25k median seq, about 200GB egress/day during POC. I'll put that in the SSO/infra ticket.
marco_security: I'll assemble the security one-pager and attach SOC2 snapshot. ETA 6 hours. :clock6: 
emily_sales: Great — plan: (1) ryan to get IdP metadata (2) marco one-pager (3) legal to draft POC SOW and egress stub (4) sam to size nodes and propose POC rate. If we can hit EOD Fri we keep deal momentum. 
steph_exec: marking as priority. If needed, can join customer call tomorrow 10am to unblock exec questions. :telephone_receiver: 
emily_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll compile a short briefing for Steph and HelixData execs once we have docs. :thumbsup:
